title: POS cash movement and PPOB replay financial safety
businessRules: Cash withdrawal cannot exceed the shift's remaining cash after earlier CASH_OUT and cash refunds, even when the supervisor approves.

Cashier movement creation must use existing IdempotencyReceipt in the same database transaction, with a per-operator key and immutable branch/type/amount/reason fingerprint; replay remains safe after shift close.
POS must preserve the same movement idempotency key through transport uncertainty and supervisor approval retries, regenerating only on a changed intended movement or confirmed success.
PPOB replay may return only the authenticated branch and original operator transaction with the same SKU/destination/requested max-price; conflicting request replays fail closed.

Single-use supervisor grants use unpredictable nonces and are redeemable only by their original company, branch, operator and action; denied cross-operator/cross-branch attempts cannot spend the rightful operator's grant.

Cash movement amounts must be finite, at least 0.01 and have no more than two decimal places before being fingerprinted or written, because the canonical idempotency request hash uses a two-decimal money representation.
Financial transaction lifecycle, PPOB prepayment, journal postings and shift variance settlement are not implemented by this hardening; do not claim product readiness.
No gate, quality assertion, provider evidence or Human Stage-20 acceptance is relaxed or synthesized.
acceptanceCriteria: Cash-out rejects overdrawn drawer balances and repeated small withdrawals consume the available float.
Idempotent retry of CASH_IN/CASH_OUT cannot create a second movement/audit record and rejects altered payload.
Cashier terminal retains its request key after authorization, failure and network timeout.
PPOB replays refuse different branches, users, SKU, target and maxPrice without returning other operators' transaction payload.
Captured supervisor grants cannot be used by another cashier or sister branch, and concurrent issuance does not collide.
Sub-cent cash amounts are rejected before the two-decimal idempotency fingerprint is computed.
PostgreSQL+SQLite transaction rehearsals, browser/HTTP UAT and full official GitHub gates are still required before closure.

With npm ci and disposable SQLite/PostgreSQL instances, replay cash movement with same/different payload, concurrent CASH_OUT, close-shift replay and double PPOB submissions across operators/branches.

npm run uat:pre-github:local; after complete dependencies and full successful gate, require exact-commit Workflow Governance + Full System Simulation + Full Automated UAT and Human Stage-20 separately.

Verify accounting journal debit equals credit for existing sale tender posting and that cash-in/out hardening creates no unsupported standalone journal entries; verify CashMovement-to-finance gap remains a release blocker.

Exercise offline/sync retry and conflict controls: identical idempotency key plus same payload returns the original row, altered payload rejects, and same PPOB company-key across branches fails without leaking row data.
migrationPlan: None. Existing IdempotencyReceipt persists cash movement retry receipts; no Prisma schema change or database migration.
rollbackPlan: Rollback application code and keep all IdempotencyReceipt/CashierCashMovement/DigitalServiceTransaction records immutable; do not delete or rewrite historical finance facts.
monitoringPlan: Monitor cash overdraft denials, mismatched idempotency requests, stalled PROCESSING receipts, concurrent shift operations and PPOB replay conflicts by branch/operator. Never log customerNo or provider credential in observability.
securityNotes: Tenant identity comes from trusted AuthUser companyId/branchId, not DTO. PPOB 404 prevents cross-branch/user information leakage. No live provider credential is included.
